This test exercises the "go_workspace" MCP tool.

-- flags --
-mcp
-min_go_command=go1.23

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.23.0

//@mcptool("go_workspace", `{}`, output=workspace)

-- a/a.go --
package a

-- b/b.go --
package b

-- @workspace --
The `$WORKDIR` directory uses Go modules, with the following main modules:
	$WORKDIR/go.mod (module example.com)
